title: Filenode spec: remove maxSpaceStorageBytes, use standard overQuota SetError
description:
Edit draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00.md to:

1. Remove maxSpaceStorageBytes (optional, UnsignedInt) from the account-level capability object around line 106.

2. In any text that previously referenced enforcing maxSpaceStorageBytes (grep to find all sites), replace with language that uses the standard overQuota SetError from RFC 8620 §5.3. Suggested phrasing:

   'When a FileNode/set operation would cause the Space file tree storage usage to exceed the implementation-defined limit for the owning Space, the server MUST reject the entry with a standard overQuota SetError (see RFC 8620 §5.3). Servers MAY surface the per-Space storage limit via JMAP Quotas [JMAP-QUOTAS] once that specification is stable.'

3. JMAP-QUOTAS is already in the informative references of the core draft; verify that the filenode draft has or adds an informative reference to it if cited.

4. Grep filenode draft and all guides for any other references to maxSpaceStorageBytes — zero matches expected after edit.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rE 'maxSpaceStorageBytes' *.md returns zero matches outside OLD/. The filenode capability object no longer lists the field. overQuota error pathway is documented for FileNode/set storage overflow. Internal cross-references are consistent.
close_reason: Pattern B applies to chat composition limits only; filenode maxSpaceStorageBytes stays as-is (already Pattern C: optional per-Space cap, uses standard overQuota, defers to JMAP-QUOTAS when absent). No filenode changes needed for this epic. Reopen if scope expands to full Pattern B everywhere.
